subject: maths
question: If two successive discounts of 10% and 5%, are given, then what will be the net discount percentage?
solution:
Given:

Two successive discounts =10% and 5%

Concept Used:

Discounted Value = Actual Value(1 - Discount%)

Calculation:

Let the MP be 100

After 1st discount of 10% price becomes (100 -10)%

⇒ 90

After 2nd discount of 5% price becomes {90 - (5% of 90)}

⇒ 90 - (9)/(2) = 90 - 4.5 = 86.45

∴ The net discount offered to the buyer is (100 - 86.45)

⇒ 14.5% 

∴ Net discount is 14.5%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** For effective discount we can use, 

⇒ a + b - (a × b)/100,

where a and b are two discounts

⇒ 10 + 5 - (10 × 5)/100

⇒ 15 - 0.5

⇒ 14.5

 ∴ Net discount is 14.5%
